notes: SugarBeanModule is the mined abstraction for SuiteCRM's generic v8 JSON:API single-record surface (POST/PATCH/DELETE /modules/{module}/{id}); it is intentionally thin and does not enumerate every module's columns.
Relationship create/update/delete are modeled as update.relation_link against the undeclared ModuleLink through-table, matching the mined to_many M2M-relationship-row effects.
oauth_token models the OAuth2Token row the mined OAuth.token effect inserts; the access_token/refresh_token strings are stored as the issued token.

calendaraccount_testconnection emits a CalendarAccountLog event on an undeclared table (accepted: the task built on it is a connectivity probe), matching the source's testConnection which calls an external sync class.
campaign_optoutremoveme records the opt-out as a 'removed' campaign activity; the source side-effect on email_addresses.opt_out is represented by this row.
